meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 16-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (5 agents) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发布前自动审查代码变更，确保质量达标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在npm发布前需要多维度自动化代码审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review code changes before release to ensure quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent automated code review before npm publish

howto.what: 在你发布 npm 包之前,Claude 会先找出所有还没发布的改动,把它们分组,派出最多 10 个分析代理逐个审查每个改动的正确性和风险,再用 5 个代理做整体审查,最后由 1 个总代理综合判断发布是否就绪、版本号该升多少,并给出报告。
howto.when: 只有当你明确要求做发布前审查时才触发,例如说“pre-publish review”“review before publish”等关键词,或直接要求“发布前检查”。普通的发布请求不会触发。

say.text: 请对我的改动做一次发布前审查。
say.note: Claude 会开始检测未发布改动并派出代理审查。

say.text: 看看这些改动能不能安全发布?
say.note: Claude 会综合评估并给出风险等级。

howto.what_en: Before you publish an npm package, Claude will detect all unpublished changes, group them, spawn up to 10 analysis agents to review each group, run a 5-agent holistic review, and have one oracle synthesize overall release readiness, version bump, and risks into a report.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for a pre-publish review, e.g. saying 'pre-publish review' or 'review before publish'. A plain publish request will not trigger it.

say_en.text: Please run a pre-publish review on my changes.
say_en.note: Claude will detect unpublished changes and start review agents.

say_en.text: Can I safely publish these changes?
say_en.note: Claude will assess risk and give a verdict.
